top_signals.title: BlackRock Explores Premium Bitcoin ETF to Boost Yields
top_signals.summary: BlackRock is preparing a second Bitcoin ETF that would sell call options on its existing IBIT shares to generate premium income for investors[2]. This follows the firm's established success with spot Bitcoin products, aiming to enhance returns in a yield-hungry institutional landscape. top_signals.title: Clawdbot AI Vulnerability Exposes Critical Security Risks
top_signals.summary: Security researchers uncovered a flaw in Clawdbot AI, a viral crypto assistant, that leaked API keys, credentials, and private chat logs across hundreds of servers[3]. The vulnerability stemmed from improper access controls, compromising user data in a tool popular for on-chain analysis. top_signals.summary: More than 60% of leading US banks, including JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, and Citigroup, are now exploring or directly offering Bitcoin trading and custody services[4]. This shift marks a tipping point in mainstream financial intermediation, driven by client demand and maturing regulatory clarity. top_signals.title: Ledger Targets $4B Valuation in US IPO
top_signals.summary: French hardware wallet leader Ledger is planning a 2026 US IPO on the New York exchange, eyeing a valuation exceeding $4 billion with advisors Goldman Sachs and Jefferies[6]. The move follows years of hardware dominance and Recover service expansion. Structurally, it represents a landmark exit for crypto infrastructure, affirming hardware security as a defensible moat in self-custody amid rising retail adoption.
